question: Which bowler has the lowest bowling average per wicket taken?
sql:
-- AC Gilchrist is the only bowler with 0 runs conceded and 2 wickets taken
-- Bowling average = 0.0 which is the lowest possible
-- Let me confirm the answer is just the bowler name

SELECT p.player_name
FROM (
    SELECT 
        b.bowler,
        SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(e.extra_runs, 0)) as total_runs_conceded
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs 
        ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs e 
        ON b.match_id = e.match_id AND b.over_id = e.over_id AND b.ball_id = e.ball_id
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.bowler
) br
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        b.bowler,
        COUNT(*) as wickets_taken
    FROM wicket_taken w
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON w.match_id = b.match_id AND w.over_id = b.over_id AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.bowler
) bw ON br.bowler = bw.bowler
JOIN player p ON br.bowler = p.player_id
WHERE bw.wickets_taken > 0
ORDER BY 1.0 * br.total_runs_conceded / bw.wickets_taken ASC
LIMIT 1;

{"sql": "-- Now compute total runs conceded per bowler and total wickets taken per bowler
-- Bowling average = runs_conceded / wickets_taken (lower is better)

WITH bowler_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.bowler,
        SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(e.extra_runs, 0)) as total_runs_conceded
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs 
        ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs e 
        ON b.match_id = e.match_id AND b.over_id = e.over_id AND b.ball_id = e.ball_id
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT 
        b.bowler,
        COUNT(w.player_out) as wickets_taken
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN wicket_taken w 
        ON b.match_id = w.match_id AND b.over_id = w.over_id AND b.ball_id = w.ball_id
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.bowler
)
SELECT 
    br.bowler,
    br.total_runs_conceded,
    bw.wickets_taken,
    CASE WHEN bw.wickets_taken > 0 THEN 1.0 * br.total_runs_conceded / bw.wickets_taken ELSE NULL END as bowling_average
FROM bowler_runs br
JOIN bowler_wickets bw ON br.bowler = bw.bowler
WHERE bw.wickets_taken > 0
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 10;", "preview_rows": 12}
